caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a bonnet composed of a netted lace material, primarily colored in shades of brown and cream. The bonnet has a wide brim that curves outward and is decorated with horizontal bands of ruffled brown ribbon. The netting is patterned with large, brown leaf-like shapes, and is further adorned around the edge with a scalloped lace border featuring hanging teardrop shapes. Inside the brim, a fine mesh veil extends slightly forward. The overall structure of the bonnet is held together with an interior metal frame. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, lightly sketched side view of the bonnet on a person's head, showing the fit and coverage of the piece. The drawing is set against a plain, beige background, and the artist's name, "Nancy Crimi," is written in the lower left corner.
title: Headdress
